comments.author: @WorldExplorer1-j5t
comments.text: 😳 Myanmar looks beautiful on the surface, but the customs and realities behind the scenes are something most tourists never see. How much of this country remains hidden from the outside world?

replies.author: @GlobeDiscovery-NY
replies.text: You hit the nail on the head! Most travel itineraries only scratch the surface with the iconic pagodas and scenic lakes. In reality, a vast majority of Myanmar—especially the remote ethnic borderlands and deep cultural traditions—remains entirely untouched and hidden due to both geography and complex history. It’s a land where ancient customs still dictate daily life far beyond what cameras usually capture. Thank you for such an insightful observation! 🇲🇲✨
